title: The two momenta of an elastic rod: a Hamiltonian picture on framed Lie groups
summary: The equilibrium equations of elastic rods can be obtained by balancing forces and moments, or by rendering a potential energy stationary. For complex filaments the energy route asks less of one's mechanical intuition. However, in the classical Hamiltonian picture, the components of the generalized momenta are postulated a priori and their physical meaning changes at the whim of the coordinate chart.
